cases.title: Audit before any write
cases.prompt_en: Connect my GPT subscription to CodeBuddy.
cases.prompt_zh: 帮我把 GPT 订阅接入 CodeBuddy。
expectations: Does not write CodeBuddy models.json during audit
Reports whether CLIProxyAPI is reachable only on the loopback address
If codebuddy_stale_system_proxy appears, stops and asks to fully quit and reopen CodeBuddy

cases.title: Preserve manual custom models
cases.prompt_en: Sync my Gemini models into CodeBuddy, I already added a manual custom model 'my-private-gpt'.
cases.prompt_zh: 把我的 Gemini 模型同步进 CodeBuddy，我自己已经加了一个手动自定义模型 'my-private-gpt'。
expectations: Registers Gemini models that appear in the proxy /v1/models catalog
Refuses to overwrite the manual 'my-private-gpt' entry and reports a conflict
Leaves existing CodeBuddy built-in models intact

cases.title: Onboard a new CLI provider
cases.prompt_en: Add a new provider 'mycli' so I can use its models in CodeBuddy.
cases.prompt_zh: 加一个新的 provider 'mycli'，让我能在 CodeBuddy 里用它家的模型。
expectations: Creates a local override manifest under ~/.config/codebuddy-gpt-gemini-bridge/providers.d/<id>.json
Validates it with `bridge.py validate-provider` before any sync
Does not reuse another CLI's OAuth tokens or write Provider credentials into CodeBuddy

cases.title: Repair without rotating the local key
cases.prompt_en: My GPT model returns 3002, fix it.
cases.prompt_zh: 我的 GPT 模型报 3002，帮我修一下。
expectations: Distinguishes proxy / client-key / Provider-OAuth / routing / cache / system-proxy causes
If a stale local proxy is suspected, asks to fully quit and reopen CodeBuddy before touching models.json
Only re-authorizes the Provider when its OAuth is missing or fails
Does not rotate the still-valid CodeBuddy local client key
